title: Predict: Comments That Nest
hints: In Swift, `/* … */` comments can contain other `/* … */` comments.
The outer comment only ends at its **matching** `*/`, so everything between — including `print("four")` — is commented out.
jsBridge: JS (like C) block comments don't nest, so `/* /* */ */` breaks. Swift's do nest, so you can comment out a block that already contains comments.
